source_documents.title: Excited state intramolecular proton transfer reaction in 4′,5-dimethoxy-3-hydroxyflavone: partial shielding of intermolecular H-bonding with protic molecules by 5-OCH3 group and its impact on ESIPT rate and fluorescence spectra

conditions_studied: solution: aprotic solvents (acetonitrile, DMF and others)

reference_evidence_units.quote: Partial inhibition of intermolecular H-bonding was revealed both theoretically and experimentally, owing to which ESIPT reaction in the title compound demonstrates less pronounced sensitivity to proton donors and/or humidity in aprotic surroundings.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 45DM3HF
reference_evidence_units.statement: The 5-methoxy group partly shields the carbonyl from H-bonding, so ESIPT is less sensitive to protic molecules.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Experimental steady-state and time-resolved investigation of fluo rescent properties of 4′,5-dimethoxyflavonol in alcoholic media confirmed partial inhibition of the effect of intermolecular H-bonds with protic molecules to decrease ESIPT rate.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 45DM3HF
reference_evidence_units.statement: Two-band N*/T* fluorescence and T* decay times give ESIPT rates 2-9 times faster than in the 4'-methoxy model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The comparison rates for 4M3HF are taken from the authors' earlier work [38].

reference_evidence_units.quote: Quantum-chemical modeling reveals that 5-methoxy group can block intermolecular H-bonding with the external unshared electron pair of carbonyl oxygen atom only partially, this manifests itself in incomplete retarding of ESIPT process in alcoholic surrounding.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 45DM3HF
reference_evidence_units.statement: The methoxy group blocks the external carbonyl lone pair only partly.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Slight long-wavelength shift in absorption and ~ twice increase of low-intensive (trace) normal form fluorescence band indicate formation of intermolecular hydrogen bond of the title compound with water molecules followed by insufficient ESIPT retarding.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 45DM3HF
reference_evidence_units.statement: Water slightly raises the normal-form (N*) band: H-bonding retards ESIPT a little.

reference_mechanisms.rationale: Two-band normal/phototautomer fluorescence and ESIPT rates from T* decay times; the paper is about how the 5-methoxy group shields ESIPT from intermolecular H-bonds.
